summary.headline: Sun’s Ingress into Taurus
summary.text: Astrological table for the Sun’s ingress into Taurus, giving the eight angles, lesser divisions, and timed planetary positions by signs, degrees, minutes, and seconds. An accompanying prognostication concerns Ramadan dates, enmity, thieves, bloodshed, weather, animals, public instability, pomegranates, and royal favor.
